name: Yuukyuu no Kanon
source:
A romance training simulation game where girls battle with other girls and monsters to collect the "ore" necessary for growth of magical flowers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一款恋爱养成模拟游戏。女孩们与其他女孩及怪物战斗，收集培育魔法花朵所需的“矿石”。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
